superseded_failed_entries.name: inventory-asan
superseded_failed_entries.status: validation aborted; original receipt is partial
superseded_failed_entries.reason: Original default-sandbox run reached a LeakSanitizer ptrace restriction at the empty oracle case; retry with the same compiler/runtime/reference hashes outside that sandbox.

sanitizer_note: Initial sandbox runs failed because LeakSanitizer could not use ptrace. The 12 general-suite commands were repeated unchanged outside the sandbox. The inventory retry used the same source/compiler/runtime/reference inputs and changed only its runner/output location. Leak detection stayed enabled. Its initial receipt is partial and the failure log is retained. Generated code and runtime dependencies are instrumented; prebuilt Rust standard library is not.
provenance_limits: General-suite receipts capture commands, logs and compiler/runtime hashes before/after, but not pre-run test-source or external Python/Clang hashes. The focused receipt captures all 70 test-source hashes and tool hashes; these sources match the measured commit.

Cargo validation retains commands, exit statuses and log hashes, without a per-command source snapshot. The subsequent clean final compiler/runtime build records its source hashes and embedded contents.
The development integration compiler was initially copied and hashed, without its own build-source receipt. Its bytes match the final clean-commit compiler; the runtime artifacts also match.
